data.title: 约尔·福杰 · 浅滩波光中的纯情反差
data.action: 赤足站在齐小腿深的清澈海水中，双手握拳羞怯地抵在胸前，双膝微微内扣，满脸通红、慌乱无措地抬眸望向对方
data.location: 无人珊瑚海湾，浅滩波光与白沙交织处
data.lighting: 温暖的午后日光斜射水面，清澈水波的焦散波纹在雪白肌肤与黑色泳装上流转
data.camera: 微俯角正面偏侧中景，聚焦羞红面容与挂脖露背泳装的曼妙身姿
data.mood: 纯情羞赧、局促无措、心跳加速的天然呆反差
data.description: 阳光倾泻的无人珊瑚浅滩，约尔身着暗夜黑玫瑰挂脖露背泳装，局促地立在清澈的海水中。平日习惯了厚实常服与严密礼裙的她，面对露背与薄透泳装大片裸露的肌肤显得手足无措。她双手攥拳抵在胸前，双颊与耳根红透，眼神慌乱却真挚地抬眸轻语——“劳、劳埃德先生……这身泳装真的没问题吗？总觉得后背凉飕飕的……像我这样不擅长打扮的人穿成这样，果然……还是会显得很奇怪吧？”
data.promptProse: Yor Forger standing calf-deep within transparent turquoise shallows on a quiet coral cove. She is dressed in a striking midnight-black halter swimsuit featuring a backless design accented by delicate crisscross cords and a blood-red fabric rose brooch. Clenching her fists shyly against her chest with an overwhelming crimson blush across her lovely face, her assassin's prowess is completely disarmed by charming, pure-hearted bashfulness. Brilliant sunlight plays across the turquoise shallows, casting dynamic dancing water caustics and golden highlights over her wading silhouette.
data.animaCaption: Yor stands in clear, calf-deep water by a quiet coral cove, as the gentle surf laps around her legs. Brilliant sunlight plays across the turquoise shallows, casting dynamic dancing water caustics and golden highlights over her wading silhouette.
